## Narrowband signatures of two targets + biologicals

```{r}

      ## Bands from config/nafc_study1.json (dolphin nudged on bands 1,3,4)
      kiloA <- c(40, 120, 310, 1080, 1480)
      kiloB <- c(40, 170, 400, 1230, 1590)

      bioShrimp <-    c(40, 90, 270, 1020, 1650)
      bioDolphin <-   c(45, 185, 320, 1250, 1400)
      bioWhale <-     c(40, 105, 430, 1270, 1510)
      bioWhitefish <- c(40, 195, 450, 1300, 1670)

      
      stim <- data.frame(target = rep(c("Kilo-A","Kilo-B","Shrimp","Dolphin","Whale","Whitefish"),each=5),
                         band = c(kiloA,kiloB,bioShrimp, bioDolphin,bioWhale,bioWhitefish))
library(ggplot2)
      
stim |> ggplot(aes(y=target,x=band)) + geom_point() + theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
plotWaterfall<- function(signature, title)
{
  ##there should be three bands, 0-250, 250-750, and 750-1750.
  green <- "green3"
  bandwidth <- 1
 par(bg="black",fg=green)
  plot(0,0,xlim=c(0,100),ylim=c(0,4),type="n",bty="n",xlab="",ylab="",axes=F,main=title)
  title(main=title,col.main="red")
  row1 <- signature[signature<250]
  row2 <- signature[signature>=250&signature<750]
  row3 <- signature[signature>=750]
  
  ymin <- 3
  ymax  <- ymin+.8
  xmin <- 0
  xmax <- 250
  for(i in row1)
  {
    valx <- (i - xmin)/(xmax-xmin)*100
    rect(valx-bandwidth,ymin,valx+bandwidth,ymax,col=green)
  }
  
  ymin <- 2
  ymax  <- ymin+.8
  xmin <- 250
  xmax <- 750
  for(i in row2)
  {
    valx <- (i - xmin)/(xmax-xmin)*100
    rect(valx-bandwidth,ymin,valx+bandwidth,ymax,col=green)
  }

    ymin <- 1
  ymax  <- ymin+.8
  xmin <- 750
  xmax <- 1750
  for(i in row3)
  {
    valx <- (i - xmin)/(xmax-xmin) * 100
    rect(valx-bandwidth,ymin,valx+bandwidth,ymax,col=green)
  }
segments(0,1:3,100,1:3)
segments(0,2:4-.2,100,2:4-.2)

}


```

```{r, fig.width=5,fig.height=3}
par(mfrow=c(2,1),mar=c(0,0,2,0))
plotWaterfall(kiloA,"Kilo-877 A")
plotWaterfall(kiloB,"Kilo-877 B")
```

```{r,fig.width=3,fig.height=5}
par(mfrow=c(3,1),mar=c(0,0,2,0))
plotWaterfall(kiloA,"Kilo-877 A")
plotWaterfall(bioDolphin,"Dolphin")
plotWaterfall(bioShrimp,"Shrimp")

par(mfrow=c(3,1),mar=c(0,0,2,0))
plotWaterfall(kiloB,"Kilo-877 B")
plotWaterfall(bioWhitefish,"Whitefish")
plotWaterfall(bioWhale,"Whale")

```
